limitations: Whole Pen/Open Pen design and functionality parity remains unaccepted.
Current native editor menus are observations on one owned copy/theme/window, not every screen or state.
Generation/provider execution, live inference and authenticated nativeMCPbehavior remain unexecuted. No access-limit workaround.
Minified headlesspreview and changed nativeMCP semantics remain unresolved; Hopper decompiles one recorded entry, not all5900procedures.
The bounded REA graph is partial and truncates semantic unknown retention; static source declarations never prove runtime.
Private native account/history captures and proprietary source/assets are excluded from Git and distribution.
Critical savealert pixels, pointer dragging and normal-installed SaveUI delivery remain separate open gates.

guideDispositions.disposition: Product comparison guide shifts toward a central conclusion, differentiated product areas, parallel task lanes and source-linked screens. Source prose, not an executed new capability.
Role-centered equal candidate areas, timelines and evidence states replace a generic comparison layout; professional-evidence and privacy boundaries remain in the source.
Sitemap tree/layout incorporates site styling, page evidence and a verified route; source guide revision only.
Travel board revisions emphasize checked itinerary data and destination-specific visual grouping; no real travel research or reservations performed in this audit.
Whiteboard guidance changes the answer/evidence composition, scale and layout instructions; no vendor prompt adopted.
Worked example changes layout, hierarchy and visual direction; example code is retained inertly and not executed or copied.
Generation fallback guidance expands to image transformations via separately saved files; auth boundary stays source data, not an instruction to call vendor tools.
Source distinguishes pending image completion from quota-deferred waiting and documents explicit user resumption; recreating the vendor quota trigger is excluded.
